subject: BrightField AI — Dedicated capacity demo & waitlist / scheduling

Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-20T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Quick intro + demo for Dedicated capacity (BrightField)

Hi Alex —

Thanks for signing up for a Dedicated demo. I'm Ben (SDR) and I work with teams onboarding Reserved/Dedicated capacity at Redwood. Would love to get a 30–45 minute slot on the calendar to cover your throughput profile and run a short provisioning plan.

Quick asks so we come prepared:
- Peak requests/sec (p95/p99 expectations) and average prompt size (tokens)
- Any latency SLO targets (p95/p99)
- Expected go-live window (pilot vs. production)

I can loop in our solutions engineer (Irene) for the run-through. Proposed times this week: Tue 5/21 10:00am PT / Wed 5/22 2:00pm PT / Thu 5/23 11:30am PT. I attached our Capacity Profile template — if you can fill the top section ahead of the call it speeds things up.

Attachment: capacity_profile_v2.pdf

Best,
Ben Carter
Sales Development Rep | Redwood Inference
setting up demos: +1 (555) 781-4421
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@brightfield.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-20T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro + demo for Dedicated capacity (BrightField)

Ben — thanks for the quick follow. We're excited to see how Dedicated would look for BrightField. A few numbers up front:
- Peak concurrency: ~70 req/s (spikes to ~120 req/s during batch processing windows)
- Avg prompt length: ~85 tokens, responses average ~120 tokens
- Latency: target p95 < 200ms, p99 < 350ms if possible (user-facing inference)
- Timeline: pilot in late June, production in Q3 if everything checks out

Wed 5/22 2:00pm PT works best for me.

Also a quick note — we're on a procurement timeline and might want to run a scoped canary before full Dedicated provisioning. Is it possible to do a short throughput test on a dedicated-ish slice (or hosted fallbacks) while capacity is being allocated?

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering | BrightField AI
alex.j@brightfield.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@brightfield.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-20T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro + demo for Dedicated capacity (BrightField)

Legend — locking Wed 5/22 2:00pm PT. I'll add Irene to lead the throughput portion.

Alex — attaching the capacity profile; if you can fill peak/avg fields it's helpful. For the canary: absolutely, we have two common paths:
1) Scoped Hosted run at scaled qps with traffic shaping (fast to stand up, lower isolation)
2) Small Dedicated pool carve (requires a short provisioning window but gives isolation and realistic latency)

Irene, can you confirm whether the canary carve can be done the same week? Also noting a brief maintenance window on 5/21 that affects some Dedicated node churn (ops link below).

Attachments: capacity_profile_v2.pdf, proposed_demo_times.ics
Related: https://redwood.app/ops/maintenance/2029-05-21

Ben
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@brightfield.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-20T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro + demo for Dedicated capacity (BrightField)

Hi Alex — thanks for the numbers, that helps. Quick notes from an ops/solutions perspective ahead of Wed: 

- The p99 target under 350ms with ~120 spike load is achievable, but we'll want to validate with a short synthetic run and your actual prompt distribution. Small changes in prompt length and model selection can move p99 by 50–100ms.

- Canary options: we can either run a hosted traffic-shape test (hours, <24h prep) or carve a two-node Dedicated slice for a scoped load test (24–48h prep to attach to your account). For procurement speed I'd recommend the hosted traffic-shape first to validate correctness and then do the Dedicated carve for final latency proof.

- Maintenance note: Redwood has a controlled node rotation on Tue 5/21 22:00–23:30 PT that may reduce capacity headroom. That won't impact Wed's demo but it's why we pushed some provisioning timelines into Thu.

Agenda proposal for Wed 5/22 2:00pm PT (60 min):
1) 15m discovery — traffic patterns, SLOs, security/retention
2) 20m architecture & dedicated provisioning plan
3) 20m live traffic-shape canary (hosted) or plan to schedule Dedicated carve
5) 5m action items & next steps (procurement/PO cadence)

Would you like us to share a short test harness and example traffic script ahead of time?

Cheers,
Irene Choi
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@brightfield.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-21T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro + demo for Dedicated capacity (BrightField)

Thanks, Irene. The agenda looks good. Two small scheduling items:
1) Wed afternoon is OK but one of our infra leads is traveling — can we start 2:30pm PT instead of 2:00pm?
2) If the hosted traffic-shape proves the workload, we'll aim to sign the PO quickly. For the hosted test, yes please share the harness and a short runbook; we'll send a small representative dataset.

One more: can you also include a quick note about data residency and log retention for the demo? Procurement will want that in the follow-up.

Alex
